about_block.headline: A Dupont, PA Electrician Built Around Safety
about_block.body: Advanced Electrical and Communications, LLC is a licensed electrical contractor based in Dupont, serving the greater Northeastern Pennsylvania area. We specialize in residential electrical service and repair, and handle jobs of every size — from a single outlet to full commercial and industrial projects. Our electricians are trained to look for the safety hazards other contractors miss, and we back that up with quick, on-time service and real customer care.

seo_body.headline: Electricians Serving Northeastern Pennsylvania
paragraphs: Electrical problems rarely announce themselves clearly. A flickering light, a warm outlet, or a breaker that trips for no obvious reason can be a minor nuisance — or the first sign of a wiring problem that gets more expensive, and more dangerous, the longer it sits. Advanced Electrical and Communications trains every electrician on staff to recognize those warning signs, not just fix the symptom in front of them.

We handle residential and commercial/industrial electrical work throughout Dupont and the surrounding Northeastern Pennsylvania communities, along with low voltage and communications wiring for homes and businesses that need more than standard power. Whatever the job, large or small, we're standing by to meet the need.
Our regular hours are Monday through Friday, 7:00am to 3:30pm, and we offer emergency service outside of that window for problems that can't wait.

faqs.a: Yes. Every electrician on our team is licensed, and trained specifically to look for safety hazards beyond just the job in front of them.

faqs.q: Do you offer emergency electrical service?
faqs.a: Yes. Our standard hours are Monday through Friday, 7:00am to 3:30pm, but emergency service is available outside of that window for problems that can't wait.
We're based in Dupont, PA and serve the greater Northeastern Pennsylvania area, including Pittston, Wilkes-Barre, Scranton, Kingston and Clarks Summit.

faqs.q: Do you handle both residential and commercial work?
faqs.a: Yes. We work on homes, businesses and industrial facilities, plus low voltage and communications wiring for both.

faqs.q: What is low voltage or communications wiring?
faqs.a: It covers wiring for systems that don't run standard household power — things like structured data cabling, security and access control wiring, and other low-voltage systems in a home or building.

faqs.q: How do I get an estimate?
faqs.a: Call 570-472-3300 or send us the details of the job through our website, and we'll get back to you to schedule a look at the work.
